title: Alice Huang’s Shady Shanghai Ties to Business and Government
zh_title: 艾丽丝·黄与上海商界和政府的不正当关系
summary: 内容摘要：黄仁勋间谍丑闻核心人物、Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 通过上海金融界建立了自己的商业网络。她与因财务不当行为而受到制裁的所谓丈夫康伟和后来涉嫌欺诈和贿赂的谷国平等人物有联系。报道称，美国情报部门认为她是中华人民共和国情报部门的合作伙伴。根据开源研究，目前尚不清楚 Alice Huang 在国家安全部 (MSS) 中的确切角色是什么
content:
内容摘要：黄仁勋间谍丑闻核心人物、Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 通过上海金融界建立了自己的商业网络。她与因财务不当行为而受到制裁的所谓丈夫康伟和后来涉嫌欺诈和贿赂的谷国平等人物有联系。报道称，美国情报部门认为她是中华人民共和国情报部门的合作伙伴。根据开源研究，目前尚不清楚 Alice Huang 在国家安全部 (MSS) 中的确切角色是什么；然而，当她结识黄仁勋时，她的兴趣和事工的兴趣很可能是一致的。黄和康利用他们的游戏业务扩展到半导体和数据中心，并在此过程中成为 Nvidia 的客户。随后，黄仁勋接管了香港游戏公司第七大道在新加坡的国际子公司第七大道国际，并通过马来西亚子公司购买了英伟达芯片。美国当局怀疑这些芯片随后被转运到中国。皇康网络与中国地方政府建立了联系。持有顾国平旗下斐讯公司股份的上海松江区投资机构，在顾国平的犯罪活动导致斐讯公司倒闭后，将股份出售给其网络中的一家公司。
科技巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 联合创始人兼首席执行官 (CEO) 黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 垮台的核心人物是一位名叫黄乐 (Huang Le) 的女性，又名 Alice Huang。媒体报道称，黄女士是英伟达在东南亚最大的客户之一、新加坡计算公司 Megaspeed 的前高管，她与黄仁勋有染。 Megaspeed 涉嫌将受美国出口管制限制的 Nvidia 芯片走私到中华人民共和国（PRC）。报道还称，美国情报部门认为黄女士已被中华人民共和国国家安全部 (MSS) 拉拢（《纽约时报》[NYT]，10 月 29 日；《华盛顿邮报》，11 月 15 日）。 [1] 北京很快否认了这些指控，但一些亲美人士认为中国的知识分子则更加持怀疑态度。他们认为当前的丑闻是特朗普政府内部以及特朗普与“深层政府”之间的内讧的结果（腾讯新闻；X/@Wuuesanren；X/@WoodenHarp，11月10日）。一位上海商人在接受采访时也表达了类似的观点，称黄女士的网络采用了复杂的、多层的公司结构来掩盖最终控制者是谁，并称这种策略是“上海滩从同治皇帝时候就玩的东西了”，指的是19世纪下半叶的早期现代化时期（作者访谈，11月10日）。他相信女士。
黄女士的目的只是将芯片走私到中国。黄出身于上海金融界，她与随后被判犯有金融犯罪的人物的关系表明，她的个人资料应该引起更多的危险信号。她的网络以一家投资公司上海和熙投资管理为中心，该公司是由她所谓的恋人、商人康伟创立的（英国《金融时报》，11 月 10 日）。该网络中的其他主要人物包括黄瑜，英国《金融时报》将其描述为黄女士的妹妹；顾国平

Executive Summary: Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed executive at the heart of the Jensen Huang spy scandal, built her business network through the world of Shanghai finance. She is linked to figures such as Kang Wei, her alleged husband who has been sanctioned for financial misconduct, and Gu Guoping, who was later implicated in fraud and bribery. Reporting indicates that U.S. intelligence considers her a cooptee of People’s Republic of China (PRC) intelligence services. It remains unclear what Alice Huang’s exact role was for the Ministry of State Security (MSS) based on open-source research; however, it is likely that her interests and that of the ministry converged around the time when she became acquainted with Jensen Huang. Huang and Kang used their gaming business to expand into semiconductors and data centers, becoming an Nvidia customer in the process. Huang then took over Hong Kong-based gaming company 7Road’s international subsidiary based in Singapore, 7Road International, and purchased Nvidia chips through a Malaysian affiliate. U.S. authorities suspect the chips were then transshipped to the PRC. The Huang-Kang network cultivated ties with local governments in the PRC. The investment arm of Shanghai’s Songjiang District, which owned a stake in Gu Guoping’s Phicomm, sold the stake to a company in their network after Phicomm failed in the wake of Gu’s criminal activity. At the center of the downfall of Jensen Huang, the co-founder and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of technology giant Nvidia, is a woman identified as Huang Le (黄乐), also known as Alice Huang. Media reporting alleges that Ms. Huang, a former executive of one of Nvidia’s largest customers in Southeast Asia, the Singapore-based computing company Megaspeed, had an affair with Jensen Huang. Megaspeed has been suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips covered by U.S. export control restrictions into the People’s Republic of China (PRC). Reports have also said that U.S. intelligence considered Ms. Huang to have been coopted by the PRC’s Ministry of State Security (MSS) ( New York Times [NYT] , October 29; Washington Post , November 15).  [1] Beijing has been quick to deny these allegations, but some pro-U.S. Chinese intellectuals are more skeptical. They view the current scandal as a consequence of infighting within the Trump administration and between Trump and the “deep state” ( Tencent News ; X/@Wuyuesanren ; X/@WoodenHarp , November 10). In an interview, a Shanghai businessman expressed a similar view, saying that Ms. Huang’s network used an elaborate, multilayered corporate structure to conceal who ultimately controlled it, calling this tactic “the sort of thing Shanghai has been doing since the time of the Tongzhi Emperor” (上海滩从同治皇帝时候就玩的东西了), referring to the period of early modernization in the second half of the 19th century (Author interview, November 10). He believed Ms. Huang’s purpose was simply to smuggle chips into the PRC. Ms. Huang emerged from the world of Shanghai finance, where her connections to figures who have subsequently been found guilty of financial crime suggest that her profile should have raised more red flags. Her network centered on an investment firm, Hexi Investment Management (上海和熙投资管理), which was founded by one her alleged romantic partners, the businessman Kang Wei (康伟) ( Financial Times , November 10). Other major figures in this network include Huang Yu (黄瑜), whom the Financial Times describes as Ms. Huang’s sister; and Gu Guoping (顾国平), the founder of communications company Phicomm (斐讯技术) ( Financial Times , November 10; Caixin , November 10).  [2] Ms. Huang co-founded Shanghai Yunxi (上海韵禧) in 2016, and Huang Yu took over the following year ( The Time Weekly , November 9). (Source: Author’s research) Gaming Served as Gateway to Data Centers For Ms. Huang, as for Nvidia, the gaming industry provided a route into the compute business. PRC game publishers often set up foreign entities to serve overseas markets, providing a legitimate reason to import graphics processors and expand data center capacity. Huang became involved with 7Road Holdings (第七大道), a Hong Kong-listed game developer, after it had acquired a portfolio of gaming businesses held by an entity wholly owned by her and registered in the British Virgin Islands ( Caizhongshe , November 11). A circular announcing the acquisition identified a company owned by Kang Wei, Ningbo Jingxuan (宁波镜瑄), as a “party acting in concert” (一致行动人) with Ms. Huang. It also listed among the portfolio’s operating entities in the PRC a company previously owned by a subsidiary of Century Huatong (世紀華通), another firm with ties to Kang and Huang ( Hong Kong Exchange , September 25, 2019).  [3] With Ms. Huang now behind the scenes, Yunxi expanded her business network into the semiconductor and data center industries through cooperation with 7Road starting in 2022. A 7Road subsidiary committed renminbi (RMB) 330 million ($49 million) to a limited partnership managed by Yunxi whose sole asset was a 5.29 percent stake in a Shanghai-based semiconductor wafer manufacturer ( Hong Kong Exchange , May 24, 2022). 7Road also expanded into the data center and cloud computing businesses in 2019, offering cloud services for gaming and the possibility of third-party data center services in a cooperation framework ( Hong Kong Exchange , December 30, 2019; Hong Kong Exchange , May 9, 2021). A 7Road subsidiary involved in Huang’s gaming portfolio later became a vehicle for 7Road’s cloud computing business, buying graphics processors and servers ( Hong Kong Exchange , September 25, 2019).  [4] In 2022, it raised RMB 150 million ($24 million at the time) through a sale-and-lease-back of equipment that included 9,800 graphics processors ( Hong Kong Exchange , March 15, 2022). reported control transfers in May-Jul. 2016"}]} Notes [1] A cooptee is an MSS collaborator, whom the ministry uses for operational support—typically in exchange for favors. They can help make introductions, serve as a go-between for the MSS and a source, provide excuses for sources to travel to the PRC, or otherwise assist the MSS in its operations. The MSS may also approach these people because of the access, business, or other ability that they have to support operations ( National Interest , June 11, 2017). [2] In November 2014, CITIC Securities (中信证券) bought a 3.8 percent stake in a technology firm under a stock return swap with Hexi, helping Gu gain control of the listed company ( CSRC , May 12, 2017). Ms. Huang worked in securities financing at CITIC at the time. The deal may have brought her into contact with Kang a year before she joined Hexi ( Hexi Investment , March 17, 2017). [3] In 2014, Hexi subscribed for shares in Century Huatong connected to its acquisitions of Tianyou Software (天游软件) and Wuxi SevenCool (无锡七酷网络). In 2017, Wuxi SevenCool sold the gaming company Hangzhou Shengfeng (杭州盛锋) to Ningbo Jingxuan (宁波镜瑄), whose ultimate controller is Kang (CNINF, March 9, 2014 , March 7, 2017 ). [4] The name of this firm, Shanghai Lingsu (上海凌素), closely resembles another firm within Ms. Huang’s business network, Shanghai Lingsuda (上海领素达), which invests primarily in smart mobility and ride-hailing platforms (see the Interactive Map) ( CAIC , August 16, 2023; Hong Kong Exchange , December 23, 2024). Yunxi also entered the ownership chain of a data center holding company, also based in Shanghai, and in 2025 changed its own registered name to Shanghai Longteng Intelligent Computing Data Group (上海珑腾智算数据集团) ( Hong Kong Exchange , September 13, 2023; Times Weekly , November 9). In Shanghai business circles, it is common to register a series of companies with names that share the same Chinese characters or use different characters with the same pronunciation. Other businesspeople can then easily tell who actually controls a company from its name alone. [5] Kang had previously used companies he controlled, including Hexi, to take over three major Phicomm shareholding vehicles ( Sina Finance , August 10, 2018). [6] Such data centers under Kang’s control, with refurbishment nearing completion, would very likely use Nvidia chips smuggled into the PRC through Huang’s Megaspeed. [7] The business tactic of offering one’s spouse to another man reaches even much further back. During the Warring States period, Zichu (子楚), a prince of Qin (秦), took an interest in Zhao Ji (赵姬), the consort of the merchant Lu Buwei (吕不韦). Lu, considering how much he had already bet on Zichu to be the next King of Qin, offered Zhao Ji, who was already pregnant, to him. After Zichu became king of Qin, Lu was appointed chancellor and wielded power over the Qin court ( Records of the Grand Historian , accessed November 11). A historical conspiracy theory even held that Qin Shi Huang (秦始皇), first emperor of ancient China, was Lu and Zhao Ji’s son. In the early 2010s, PRC financial media and business books often portrayed Lu Buwei as a merchant who knew how to bet on real power (through whatever means), fueling an interest in him among businessmen of the era (see Fortune China , March 23, 2011). That was precisely when Kang rose to prominence in business. The post Alice Huang’s Shady Shanghai Ties to Business and Government appeared first on Jamestown .

title: Spartan puts $683 million price tag on Victorio moly, tungsten mine in New Mexico
zh_title: Spartan 对新墨西哥州 Victorio 钼钨矿标价 6.83 亿美元
summary: Spartan Metals（多伦多证券交易所代码：W；美国场外交易代码：SPRMF）估计，在新墨西哥州维多里奥建造一座地下钨钼矿将耗资 6.83 亿美元，并建有一座工厂，将钨精矿转化为切削工具和其他工业产品的原料。根据周四发布的初步经济评估，该项目位于州首府圣达菲西南约 440 公里处，将运营 24 年。该研究估计，按 8% 的贴现率和 31% 的内部收益率计算，税后净现值 (NPV) 为 21.4 亿美元。该项目还需要20.3亿美元
content:
Spartan Metals（多伦多证券交易所代码：W；美国场外交易代码：SPRMF）估计，在新墨西哥州维多里奥建造一座地下钨钼矿将耗资 6.83 亿美元，并建有一座工厂，将钨精矿转化为切削工具和其他工业产品的原料。根据周四发布的初步经济评估，该项目位于州首府圣达菲西南约 440 公里处，将运营 24 年。该研究估计，按 8% 的贴现率和 31% 的内部收益率计算，税后净现值 (NPV) 为 21.4 亿美元。该项目还需要 20.3 亿美元的支出来维持整个生命周期的运营。斯巴达首席执行官布雷特·马什（Brett Marsh）在新闻稿中表示：“这两种金属都对这些经济做出了贡献，因此任何一种金属的持续价格上涨都可以对潜在的项目经济产生有意义的影响。” “维多利亚可能成为美国工业和国防客户持久的国内钨和钼来源。”根据美国地质调查局的数据，美国上一次商业开采钨是在 2015 年。 S&P Global 的数据显示，中国约占全球精炼仲钨酸铵产能的 85%，仲钨酸铵是 Victorio 生产的中间产品。据 Fastmarkets 周四报道，尽管一些买家对价格上涨犹豫不决，但中国的出口管制仍导致供应紧张。周四，Spartan 股价在多伦多收于每股 26 美分不变，该公司估值约为 1,540 万加元（1,070 万美元）。
价格敏感性 该研究假设每 10 公斤三氧化钨为 1,350 美元，每磅钼为 20 美元。在测试的最低价格下，三氧化钨每 10 公斤 750 美元，钼每磅 15 美元，税后 NPV 降至 3.92 亿美元，回报率降至 14%。维多利亚会使用块崩落法，这是一种利用重力破碎岩石的地下方法。该研究预计每年可回收仲钨酸铵中约 4,100 吨三氧化钨，以及精矿中约 865 万磅钼。推断资源量占预定植物饲料的 39%。 8 月份的资源估算显示，测得和指示资源量为 7670 万吨，三氧化钨品位为 0.1%，钼品位为 0.09%，分别含有 1.655 亿磅和 1.479 亿磅。另外推断品位为 0.09% 三氧化钨和 0.06% 钼的产量为 9,240 万吨，分别为 1.876 亿磅和 1.3 亿磅。下一步 斯巴达计划将维多利亚推进到预可行性阶段。该研究建议投入 1,320 万美元的工作，包括钻探、冶金测试以及供水和尾矿研究。斯巴达对多尼根资源公司的核心索赔拥有选择权。根据 3 月份的协议，行使该权利需要现金支付、1400 万美元的勘探支出以及 2034 年之前的可行性研究。其他钨项目正在北美其他地区推进。
加拿大联邦政府周一有条件批准了 Fireweed Metals（多伦多证券交易所代码：FWZ；美国场外交易代码：FWEDF）最多 1,400 万加元的融资，以帮助推进其 Mactung 钨项目做出建设决定。

【原文 English Original】
Spartan Metals (TSXV: W; US-OTC: SPRMF) estimates it would cost $683 million to build an underground tungsten and molybdenum mine at Victorio in New Mexico, with a plant to turn tungsten concentrate into a feedstock for cutting tools and other industrial products. The project, about 440 km southwest of state capital Santa Fe, would operate for 24 years, according to a preliminary economic assessment released Thursday. The study estimates an after-tax net present value (NPV) of $2.14 billion, at an 8% discount rate, and a 31% internal rate of return. The project requires another $2.03 billion in spending to sustain the operation over its life. “Both metals contribute to those economics, so continued price appreciation for either metal can make a meaningful difference to the underlying project economics,” Spartan CEO Brett Marsh said in the release. “Victorio could become a lasting domestic source of tungsten and molybdenum for U.S. industrial and defense customers.” The United States last mined tungsten commercially in 2015, according to the U.S. Geological Survey. China accounts for about 85% of global capacity to refine ammonium paratungstate, the intermediate product Victorio would make, according to S&P Global. China’s export controls are keeping supply tight even as some buyers balk at elevated prices, Fastmarkets reported Thursday. Spartan shares closed unchanged at C26¢ apiece on Thursday in Toronto, valuing the company at about C$15.4 million ($10.7 million). Price sensitivity The study assumes $1,350 per 10 kg of tungsten trioxide and $20 per lb. of molybdenum. At the lowest prices tested, $750 per 10 kg for tungsten trioxide and $15 per lb. for molybdenum, the after-tax NPV falls to $392 million and the return to 14%. Victorio would use block caving, an underground method that uses gravity to break the rock. The study projects annual recovery of about 4,100 tonnes of tungsten trioxide contained in ammonium paratungstate and 8.65 million lb. of molybdenum in concentrate. Inferred resources account for 39% of scheduled plant feed. An August resource estimate puts measured and indicated resources at 76.7 million tonnes grading 0.1% tungsten trioxide and 0.09% molybdenum, containing 165.5 million lb. and 147.9 million lb., respectively. Another 92.4 million inferred tonnes grade 0.09% tungsten trioxide and 0.06% molybdenum, for 187.6 million lb. and 130 million lb., respectively. Next steps Spartan plans to advance Victorio to prefeasibility. The study recommends $13.2 million of work, including drilling, metallurgical testing and studies of water supply and tailings. Spartan has an option on the core claims from Donegan Resources. Exercising it requires cash payments, $14 million in exploration spending and a feasibility study by 2034 under a March agreement. Other tungsten projects are advancing elsewhere in North America. Canada’s federal government on Monday conditionally approved up to C$14 million in financing for Fireweed Metals (TSX: FWZ; US-OTC: FWEDF) to help advance its Mactung tungsten project toward a construction decision.

这对中国来说也是一个巨大的胜利。” （观看）关于空中交通管制：“这是有 50 年历史的设备，必须更换……上届政府花费了数十亿美元，然后他们试图将其连接起来，但没有成功；” “它不仅不起作用，而且还让它倒退。所以，我们希望它能得到修复，我们希望它能够正确修复……当它完成后，我们将拥有世界上最好的系统。” （观看）关于最近的技术中断：“一切都很好。这些都是个人事件……我也认为媒体对此很感兴趣。如果这些事情发生在两年前、三年前，在极其无能和腐败的拜登政府，没有人会提到它……如果有人对我们这样做并且我们发现了这件事，他们知道我会受到什么影响。没有人会和我们一起玩游戏。” （观看）关于伊朗：“他们想要达成协议，但我想要一项可以持久的协议……如果我们有一位糟糕的总统，一位软弱的总统，我想要一项能够取代总统的协议……无论如何，我们都会完成它。” （观看）关于在新国会中与民主党人合作：“民主党人对我的评价非常惊人。没有人会相信……他们想要做交易。我拥有否决权……我有一种感觉，这将是令人难以置信的富有成效的两年。

title: US lawmakers target Airbus contracts over China ties

content:
随着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普结束与中国国家主席习近平的峰会会谈，美国议员敦促美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）拒绝对中国制造的飞机进行认证，并呼吁取消继续在中国投资的航空航天公司的美国政府合同。根据 2026 年 11 月 19 日发布的国会报告，众议院中国问题特别委员会认为，西方航空航天合作伙伴关系帮助中国增强了军事实力。空中客车公司是拟议合同限制的目标公司之一。这些建议需要政府采取行动才能生效。空客与中国的合作伙伴关系此前曾引起美国立法者的审查。在 2025 年 12 月致国防部长皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 的信中，委员会主席约翰·穆勒纳尔 (John Moolenaar) 质疑这家欧洲制造商与中国的合作伙伴关系是否正在帮助参与军用飞机生产的公司。这封信特别提到了西安飞机工业集团，该集团为空客天津工厂生产A320机翼，并开发中国军用飞机。该委员会认为，商业制造工作可以为这些公司提供对军事项目有用的技能和能力。莫勒纳尔还指责法国政府通过控制空中客车公司可以向外国当局披露的信息来阻碍调查。根据他的信，空中客车公司似乎愿意合作。
根据与天津自贸区投资公司和中国航空工业集团公司（中航工业）的协议，空中客车公司于 2025 年 10 月在天津开设了第二条 A320 系列总装线。空中客车公司表示，这条额外的生产线将有助于其增加产量并为中国和其他地方的客户提供服务。其最初的天津生产线于 2008 年开业，当时已组装并交付了 780 多架 A320 系列飞机。另外，该委员会在 2026 年 11 月 13 日发布的一份报告中审查了中国的商用飞机行业。该审查描述了政府对国内制造商的广泛支持，但也发现中国在航空航天领域仍然落后于西方竞争对手。报告指出，中国商飞的C919客机仍然依赖西方发动机和航电设备，缺乏美国联邦航空局和欧盟航空安全局的认证。尽管中国航空公司为该飞机提供了国内市场，但这些批准对其在中国以外的前景仍然很重要。美国立法者因与中国关系而针对空客合同的帖子首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

【原文 English Original】
As US President Donald Trump wrapped up summit talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping, US lawmakers urged the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to refuse certification of Chinese-made aircraft and called for stripping US government contracts from aerospace companies that continue investing in China. The House Select Committee on China argues that Western aerospace partnerships have helped China to strengthen its military, according to a congressional report published on November 19, 2026. Airbus is among the companies targeted by the proposed contract restrictions. The recommendations would require government action before taking effect. Airbus’s Chinese partnerships have drawn previous scrutiny from US lawmakers. In a December 2025 letter to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, committee Chairman John Moolenaar questioned whether the European manufacturer’s Chinese partnerships were helping companies involved in military aircraft production. The letter singled out Xi’an Aircraft Industry Group, which manufactures A320 wings for Airbus’s Tianjin operation and also develops Chinese military aircraft. The committee argued that commercial manufacturing work could give those companies skills and capabilities useful to military programs. Moolenaar also accused the French government of obstructing the inquiry by controlling what Airbus could disclose to foreign authorities. According to his letter, Airbus had appeared willing to cooperate. Airbus opened a second A320-family final assembly line in Tianjin in October 2025 under an agreement with the Tianjin Free Trade Zone Investment Company and Aviation Industry Corporation of China, known as AVIC. Airbus suggested that the additional line would help it to increase production and serve customers in China and elsewhere. Its original Tianjin line, opened in 2008, had assembled and delivered more than 780 A320-family aircraft by that point. Separately, the committee examined China’s commercial aircraft industry, in a report published on November 13, 2026. The review described extensive government support for domestic manufacturers, but also found that China remained behind Western competitors in the aerospace field. It noted that COMAC’s C919 airliner still relies on Western engines and avionics, and lacks FAA and European Union Aviation Safety Agency certification. These approvals remain important to its prospects beyond China, even as Chinese airlines provide a domestic market for the aircraft. title: Taiwan and Japan Intercept Russian Tu-95 Bombers Flying Back from Vietnam
zh_title: 台湾和日本拦截从越南飞回的俄罗斯Tu-95轰炸机
summary: 11 月 17 日，两架 Tu-95 和两架 Il-76MD 出现在越南岘港国际机场，并在从俄罗斯起飞和返回时被日本和台湾发现。 2026年11月17日访问越南岘港国际机场的两架俄罗斯Tu-95熊式轰炸机于11月19日离开该国。在返回俄罗斯的途中，它们进入了台湾的防空识别区（ADIZ），中华民国空军（RoCAF）发布了其中一架熊式轰炸机被其F-16战斗机拦截的图像。当飞机继续飞行时，也遭到了战斗机的拦截。
content:
11 月 17 日，两架 Tu-95 和两架 Il-76MD 出现在越南岘港国际机场，并在从俄罗斯起飞和返回时被日本和台湾发现。 2026年11月17日访问越南岘港国际机场的两架俄罗斯Tu-95熊式轰炸机于11月19日离开该国。在返回俄罗斯的途中，它们进入了台湾的防空识别区（ADIZ），中华民国空军（RoCAF）发布了其中一架熊式轰炸机被其F-16战斗机拦截的图像。当飞机继续飞行时，它们也被日本航空自卫队（JASDF）的战斗机拦截。日本防卫省联合参谋部报告称，两架 Tu-95 与两架 Tu-142 海上巡逻机 (MPA) 和反潜战机 (ASW) 一起飞越东海北部，然后向北返回俄罗斯。这架飞机由一架 Il-76MD 和一架 Il-76MD-90A 陪同抵达越南岘港机场，为此次部署提供支持。然而，这些货运飞机和空中加油机在从俄罗斯飞往越南的途中没有被追踪到，这表明它们可能采取了不同的路线，可能飞越中国。日本和台湾在海上拦截Tu-95是在中国深圳举行亚太经合组织多国领导人非正式会议的背景下发生的。日本首相高市早苗、美国出席了此次活动。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京。今天早上总共发现了 2 架次俄罗斯 Tu-95 飞机。该飞机从南部进入#台湾防空识别区，飞经台湾以东空域，最后离开基隆东北部防空识别区。 #ROCArmedForces 已监测局势并做出相应反应。 https://t.co/tgFM55svba — 台湾国防部 (@MoNDefense) 2026 年 11 月 19 日在越南的俄罗斯飞机被台湾和日本追踪 台湾和日本也在 11 月 17 日追踪到这些飞机前往越南。日本国防部首先报告称，凌晨 4 点 07 分至 4 点 12 分期间，两架俄罗斯飞机在冲之岛西北部“侵犯领海空域”。随后飞机穿过对马海峡，进入东海，在日本与那国岛和台湾之间飞行，向南进入南海。台湾国防部当时表示，11月17日凌晨发现两架“俄罗斯军机”，它们从东北进入台湾防空识别区并向南飞行，然后转向西向越南。如前所述，飞机降落在岘港国际机场。 RoCAF 和 JASDF 拍摄的两架 Tu-95 的尾号分别为 RF-94188/Bort 43 和 RF-94202。越南飞机观察员拍摄的图像证实，这些飞机与抵达岘港的飞机是同一架。
已证实，2020年11月19日星期四上午至下午，两架俄罗斯轰炸机（Tu-95）从太平洋飞来，经过与那国岛和台湾之间，然后穿过对马海峡，飞往大陆。此外，当天上午至下午，确认有两架俄罗斯巡逻机（Tu-142）从日本海起飞，穿过对马海峡，在东海与上述俄罗斯轰炸机会合，再次穿过对马海峡，飞往大陆。对此，航空自卫队西南防空部队等战斗机紧急升空应对。 — 国防部联合参谋部 (@jointstaffpa) 2026 年 11 月 19 日 在 11 月的更新中，RoCAF 报告了两架俄罗斯飞机，但仅发布了一张 RF-94202 的图片。该部门表示，这两架飞机沿着台湾东部海域向北飞行。日本联合参谋部在描述 Tu-95 继续向北飞行以及 Tu-142 加入他们的飞行时说：“周四，没有

【原文 English Original】
Two Tu-95s, along with two Il-76MDs, appeared in Vietnam at Da Nang International Airport on Nov. 17, and were detected by Japan and Taiwan as they flew from Russia and back.  The two Russian Tu-95 Bear bombers that visited Vietnam’s Da Nang International Airport on Nov. 17, 2026, left the country on Nov. 19. On their way back to Russia, they entered Taiwan’s Air Defense Identification Zone (ADIZ), with the Republic of China Air Force (RoCAF) releasing the image of one of the Bear bombers intercepted by its F-16s.  As the aircraft continued their flight, they were also intercepted by fighters of the Japan Air Self Defense Force (JASDF). The Japanese Ministry of Defense’s Joint Staff reported that the two Tu-95s were joined by two Tu-142 Maritime Patrol Aircraft (MPA) and Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW) aircraft over the northern part of the East China Sea, before heading northwards back to Russia.  The aircraft were accompanied to Vietnam’s Da Nang airport by an Il-76MD and an Il-76MD-90A, which supported the deployment. These cargo and aerial refueling aircraft were however not tracked during the journey from Russia to Vietnam, suggesting they may have taken a different route, possibly over China. The interception of the Tu-95s over the sea by Japan and Taiwan took place in the backdrop of the multinational APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting held in Shenzhen, China. The event was attended by Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin.  Overall, 2 sorties of Russian Tu-95 aircraft were detected this morning. The aircraft entered #Taiwan’s ADIZ from the south, flew through airspace east of Taiwan, and exited the ADIZ northeast of Keelung. The #ROCArmedForces have monitored the situation and responded accordingly. https://t.co/tgFM55svba — 國防部 Ministry of National Defense, ROC(Taiwan) (@MoNDefense) November 19, 2026 Russian aircraft in Vietnam, tracked by Taiwan and Japan Taiwan and Japan had also tracked these aircraft on Nov. 17 as they were heading to Vietnam. Japan’s MoD had first reported two Russian aircraft “violating the airspace over the territorial waters” northwest of Okinoshima Island between 4:07 am and 4:12 am. The aircraft then passed through the Tsushima Strait, entered the East China Sea, heading southwards into the South China Sea by flying between Japan’s Yonaguni Island and Taiwan. Taiwan’s MND said at the time it detected two “sorties of Russian military aircraft” early in the morning of Nov. 17, which they entered Taiwan’s ADIZ from the northeast and headed south, before turning west toward Vietnam. As mentioned earlier, the aircraft landed at Da Nang International Airport. The two Tu-95s photographed by the RoCAF and the JASDF had tail numbers RF-94188/Bort 43 and RF-94202. Images from Vietnamese aircraft spotters confirmed these were the same aircraft which arrived in Da Nang. 令和８年１１月１９日（木）午前から午後にかけて、ロシアの爆撃機（Ｔｕ－９５）×２機が、太平洋から飛来し、与那国島と台湾との間を通過した後、対馬海峡を通過し大陸方面へ飛行したことを確認した。 また、同日午前から午後にかけて、ロシアの哨戒機（Ｔｕ－１４２）×２機が、日本海から飛来し、対馬海峡を通過した後、東シナ海上で上記のロシア爆撃機と合流し、再び対馬海峡を通過し大陸方面へ飛行したことを確認した。 これに対し、航空自衛隊の南西航空方面隊等の戦闘機を緊急発進させ対応した。 — 防衛省統合幕僚監部 (@jointstaffpa) November 19, 2026 In the update on Nov., the RoCAF reported two Russian aircraft, but released a picture of only RF-94202. The service said the pair flew north along Taiwan’s eastern waters. Describing the flight of the Tu-95s as they continued north and the Tu-142s that joined them, the Japanese Joint Staff said: “On Thursday, November 19, 2026, from morning into the afternoon, two Russian bombers (Tu-95) were confirmed to have flown in from the Pacific, passed between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan, then flown through the Tsushima Strait toward the Asian mainland. Also on the same day, from morning into the afternoon, two Russian patrol aircraft (Tu-142) were confirmed to have flown in from the Sea of Japan, passed through the Tsushima Strait, joined the Russian bombers mentioned above over the East China Sea, then flown through the Tsushima Strait again toward the Asian mainland. In response, the Japan Air Self-Defense Force scrambled fighter aircraft from the Southwestern Air Defense Force and other units to address the situation.” Russian Air Force Tu-95MS left Da Nang earlier today before sunrise. Well thanks APEC to give us a very very rare chance to see this classic Russian bomber. https://t.co/k3cCKPvQmG — Wang Shao-Hsiang (@hsiangwang324) November 19, 2026 Before the Russian aircraft appeared in Vietnam, Tu-95MS bombers were among Russian military aircraft participating in exercises in the far northeast Asian region on Nov. 16-17, according to analyst AviVector . The account said that a total of five Tu-95s and three Il-78Ms had departed Ukrainka Air Base, in far-eastern Russia, late in the afternoon of Nov. 16. Today, three Tu-95MS and three Il-78M from Ukrainka Air Base conducted an 11-hour training flight over the Sea of Japan. An A-50U (RF-94268, 41 Red) from Vladivostok Airport conducted a reconnaissance flight over the Sea of Japan. Two Tu-95MS (RF-94202, 43 Red; RF-94188, 44 Red) from Ukrainka Air Base were redeployed to Da Nang Airport, Vietnam. — AviVector (@avivector) November 17, 2026 They were supported by an A-50U Mainstay Airborne Early Warning (AEW) aircraft which took off from Vladivostok airport. While all the Il-78s landed back at 3 am, only three Tu-95s returned to Ukrainka, suggesting two of those Bear bombers headed to Vietnam. It should be noted that this is not the first time Russian aircraft have operated inside Taiwan’s ADIZ. In fact, this already happened in 1986 and January 2010, Taiwanese military analyst Chieh Chung told Focus Taiwan . In a separate incident, the Japanese MoD also reported on Nov. 19 a TB-001 surveillance-strike UCAV which flew over the East China Sea eastwards toward the Danjo Islands in the Nagasaki Prefecture. The drone turned back off the coast of Okinawa, before heading back to the Chinese mainland. Also called the ‘Twin-Tailed Scorpion’, the drone has begun emerging frequently around Japan. Russian Air Force Tu-95MS left Da Nang earlier today before sunrise. Well thanks APEC to give us a very very rare chance to see this classic Russian bomber. https://t.co/k3cCKPvQmG — Wang Shao-Hsiang (@hsiangwang324) November 19, 2026 Diplomatic overview The Russian bombers’ visit to Vietnam came close on the heels of the multinational Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) 2026 Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China. Presidents Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping’s separate and unprecedented trilateral summit on the summit’s sidelines brought together the three permanent members of the UN Security Council (UNSC). Il-76MD, Da Nang Airport / ”Danang 35K Feet”. https://t.co/22DaoD8PLP — Massimo Frantarelli (@MrFrantarelli) November 17, 2026 Trump’s and Putin’s statements focused significantly on nuclear arms control and the war in Ukraine. While no final agreement was reached on either issue, the joint declaration mitted the three countries to dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing proliferation. This is also the third time Trump and Xi have met in a span of six months, which began with the former’s first state visit to Beijing in May. Xi made a reciprocal visit to Washington in September.
