Beijing drone ban creates cross-city storage business in Tianjin | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 23 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Beijing drone ban creates cross-city storage business in Tianjin
Beijing further tightens drone rules from 15 November, banning possession and storage within the city. This has spurred a new business in Tianjin, where shops offer storage services for annual fees of 300 to 800 yuan, drawing hundreds of inquiries and orders.
Beijing has further tightened restrictions on unmanned aerial vehicles, banning the possession or storage of drones and their core components within the city from 15 November, following an earlier blanket ban on flights. The move has created a new business opportunity in neighbouring Tianjin, located within a 30-minute high-speed rail commute, where drone users are turning to cross-city storage services.
A drone retail shop in Tianjin launched a storage service two months ago, charging annual fees ranging from over 300 to more than 800 yuan. The service includes dedicated storage space, regular battery charging, maintenance checks, and domestic courier delivery. The shop's operator said demand has been rising since late last month, with hundreds of inquiries and orders received so far.
The authorities had previously offered three disposal channels for drones — free outbound delivery, scrapping, and buyback — along with a subsidy scheme. Under the buyback option, owners selling drones at designated locations received 30 per cent of the sale price, capped at 3,000 yuan. For scrapping, each drone qualified for a 200-yuan subsidy. Some users, however, said the buyback price was 60 to 70 per cent lower than the original cost, leading them to opt for cross-city storage as a transitional measure.
The Beijing Public Security Bureau stressed it will continue to step up enforcement against illegal flights and other violations. Under the rules, anyone found illegally possessing or carrying a drone into Beijing faces confiscation of the device and a fine of up to 5,000 yuan. Cases involving illegal flights or serious violations may also lead to criminal liability.

鸿福苑火灾一年后，香港社会工作者为居民提供支持中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 23 日星期一 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
鸿福苑火灾一年后，香港社会工作者为居民提供支持
自近一年前鸿福苑发生火灾以来，社会福利署的社工一直为鸿福苑的居民提供一对一的支援。官员们表示，居民继续面临情绪挑战，而临床心理学家也为一线工作人员提供支持。
鸿福苑发生火灾近一年后，社会福利署的“一人一社工”计划继续为受影响的居民提供支援。社会工作主管严慧玲表示，有居民反映，最近有关该事件的网络和社交媒体信息影响了他们的睡眠和食欲，他们需要帮助管理情绪。
助理社工督导朱凯英一直在跟踪一名70多岁的居民。火灾发生初期，居民情绪低落，失眠多梦，经常哭泣。在过去的一年里，朱陪同该妇女去看医生并提供持续的谈话。这位原本拒绝出门的居民，现在主动邀请以前的邻居出去分享她的观察。朱说，该居民曾分享过一张鸿福苑附近日落的照片，形容这是苦难中的希望。
另一位助理社会工作主管郑龙轩(Chung Long-heun)一直在支持一名在火灾后住院的70多岁居民。该男子失去了妻子，必须处理她的葬礼、保险和住房安排。回顾过去的一年，钟先生表示，居民最需要一个能够帮助解决各种问题的陪伴者。
临床心理学家陈祥贤表示，她的职责不仅为受影响的居民提供专业支持，还为在现场工作的社工和政府人员提供专业支持。她将此描述为为团队创建了一个安全网。陈说，每个人都以自己的节奏处理悲伤，社会工作者和临床心理学家将陪伴居民和同事度过困难时期，确保他们的情绪得到接受。

Hong Kong social workers support residents a year after Hung Fook Court fire | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 23 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong social workers support residents a year after Hung Fook Court fire
Social workers from the Social Welfare Department have been providing one-to-one support to residents of Hung Fook Court since a fire nearly a year ago. Officials said residents continue to face emotional challenges, while clinical psychologists also support frontline staff.
Nearly a year after a fire at Hung Fook Court, the Social Welfare Department’s “one resident, one social worker” scheme continues to support affected residents. Social work supervisor Yim Wai-ling said some residents have reported that recent online and social media information about the incident has affected their sleep and appetite, and that they need help managing their emotions.
Assistant social work supervisor Chu Kai-ying has been following a resident in her 70s. In the early days after the fire, the resident was depressed, suffered from insomnia and often cried. Over the past year, Chu has accompanied the woman to medical appointments and provided ongoing conversation. The resident, who initially refused to leave home, now actively invites former neighbours to go out and shares her observations. Chu said the resident once shared a photo of the sunset near Hung Fook Court, describing it as a sign of hope amid hardship.
Another assistant social work supervisor, Chung Long-heun, has been supporting a resident in his 70s who was hospitalised after the fire. The man lost his wife and had to handle her funeral, insurance and housing arrangements. Reflecting on the past year, Chung said the resident most needed a companion who could help solve various problems.
Clinical psychologist Chan Cheung-yin said her role includes providing professional support not only to affected residents but also to social workers and government staff who worked at the scene. She described this as creating a safety net for the team. Chan said everyone processes grief at their own pace, and that social workers and clinical psychologists will accompany residents and colleagues through difficult times, ensuring their emotions are accepted.

香港二手房销售创数周新高中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 23 日星期一 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港二手房销售创数周新高
香港十大二手住宅录得数周来最高周末销量，机构报告有 9 至 10 笔成交。代理商将这一增长归因于缺乏新项目推出，这将买家转向二级市场。
香港房地产经纪人表示，由于没有新单位推出销售，排名前十的二手住宅小区创下了数周以来最高的周末销量。
中原地产上周末成交 9 笔，较前一周增加 1 笔，创五周新高。该机构表示，在自住业主的推动下，房地产市场一直保持稳定和改善，受益于开发商对新项目的低价策略，一级和二级市场的吸纳量都稳定。
美联地产周末录得 10 笔成交，较前一周增加 3 笔，创 12 周新高。该机构指出，虽然许多新项目正在准备推出，这占用了一些购买力，但周末没有重大新项目出售。因此，一些错失新房的购房者与其他资金一起涌入二级市场，促进了交易。

Hong Kong secondary home sales hit multi-week highs
Hong Kong's top 10 secondary housing estates recorded their highest weekend sales in weeks, with agencies reporting 9 to 10 transactions. Agents attributed the rise to a lack of new project launches, which redirected buyers to the secondary market.
Hong Kong property agents said the top 10 secondary housing estates recorded their highest weekend sales in several weeks, as no new flats were launched for sale.
Centaline Property reported nine transactions over the past weekend, up by one from the previous week, marking a five-week high. The agency said the property market has been stable and improving, driven by owner-occupiers, and that both the primary and secondary markets have seen steady take-up, benefiting from developers' low-price strategies for new projects.
Midland Realty recorded 10 transactions over the weekend, up by three from the previous week, reaching a 12-week high. The agency noted that while many new projects are being prepared for launch, which ties up some purchasing power, no major new projects were offered for sale over the weekend. As a result, some home seekers who missed out on new flats, along with other funds, flowed into the secondary market, boosting transactions.

summary: 香港学院优先考虑实践技能而非“排名游戏”以争取大学地位|中国劳工布告栏 星期一, 2026 年 11 月 23 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港学院优先考虑实践技能而不是“排名游戏”以推动大学地位 香港高等教育科技学院 (THEi) 在寻求成为一所私立大学时强调实用的行业技能和人工智能素养。校长刘艾伦表示，该学院避免“排名游戏”，而是专注于毕业生就业和行业资助的研究
content:
香港学院优先考虑实践技能而非“排名游戏”以争取大学地位|中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 23 日星期一 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港学院优先考虑实用技能而非“排名游戏”以争取大学地位
香港高等教育科技学院（THEi）在寻求成为一所私立大学的过程中强调实用的行业技能和人工智能素养。校长刘艾伦表示，该研究所避免了“排名游戏”，而是专注于毕业生就业和行业资助的研究。
香港高等教育科技学院（THEi）校长刘建德表示，在寻求转型为私立大学的过程中，香港高等教育科技学院（THEi）优先考虑培养具备实用行业技能和先进人工智能素养的人才，而不是“排名游戏”。
该研究所的领导强调，高等教育需要双轨制，其中研究密集型大学和应用科学机构发挥同样重要的作用。为了弥合学术界和就业市场之间的差距，THEi 直接与企业合作伙伴共同设计学位课程，向雇主咨询他们在招聘毕业生时寻找的具体技能，并将这些要求直接纳入课程中。
与关键绩效指标围绕学术出版物数量、政府拨款和教学的传统大学相比，THEi 通过实际成果来评估成功。刘说，其基本标准包括产业资金、可供企业使用的研究成果以及毕业生就业率。
“我们不会陷入排名游戏；我们正在寻找真正的结果，”刘说。他指出，仍然鼓励教师发表论文，但他们的研究最终必须为市场提供实用的解决方案。
这种务实的态度也体现在THEi如何应对人工智能对就业市场的影响上。刘并不将其视为威胁，而是认为人工智能是学生在求职过程中增强竞争力所必须掌握的重要工具。根据 THEi 的课程，学生在头两年掌握核心基础知识，然后在第三年和第四年整合人工智能工具。
刘强调，所有课程都要求强制进行三到六个月的行业实习，以便让学生尽早获得实践经验，几乎所有学生在毕业前三个月就找到了工作。由于人口结构的变化，THEi 预计当前的内地学生入学潮可能会在 5 至 10 年内达到顶峰，因此正在采取风险管理方法来实现学生群体的多元化。
刘说，THEi在本学年充分利用现有配额后，已向教育局申请将内地学生入学上限从30%提高至40%，同时承诺严格审查虚假学历。刘说：“学生来这里是为了学习真正的技能，而不是简单地购买文凭。”他强调THEi永远不会妥协其标准。

Hong Kong institute prioritises practical skills over 'ranking game' in push for university status | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 23 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong institute prioritises practical skills over 'ranking game' in push for university status
The Technological and Higher Education Institute of Hong Kong (THEi) emphasises practical industry skills and AI literacy as it seeks to become a private university. President Alan Lau says the institute avoids the 'ranking game', focusing instead on graduate employment and industry-funded research.
The Technological and Higher Education Institute of Hong Kong (THEi) is prioritising the fostering of talent equipped with practical industry skills and advanced AI literacy over the 'ranking game' as it seeks to transition into a private university, president Alan Lau Kin-tak said.
The institute's leader stressed that higher education requires a dual-track approach in which research-intensive universities and applied sciences institutions play equally vital roles. To bridge the gap between academia and the job market, THEi co-designs its degree programmes directly with corporate partners, consulting employers on the specific skills they look for when hiring graduates and building those requirements directly into the curriculum.
Compared with traditional universities whose key performance indicators revolve around academic publication numbers, government grants and teaching, THEi evaluates success through practical outcomes. Its fundamental criteria include funding from industry, research outcomes that can be used by businesses, and the graduate employment rate, Lau said.
'We are not falling into the ranking game; we are looking for real results,' Lau said. Faculty are still encouraged to publish papers, he noted, but their research must ultimately yield practical solutions for the market.
This pragmatic approach is also reflected in how THEi responds to the impact of artificial intelligence on the job market. Rather than viewing it as a threat, Lau believes AI is an essential tool that students must acquire to enhance their competitiveness during job searching. Under THEi's curriculum, students spend their first two years mastering core fundamentals before integrating AI tools in their third and fourth years.
Lau stressed that all courses require a compulsory three-to-six-month industry placement to equip students with hands-on experience early on, and almost all students secure a job three months before they graduate. Anticipating that the current wave of mainland student enrolments may peak within five to 10 years due to demographic shifts, THEi is adopting a risk management approach to diversify its student body.
THEi has applied to the Education Bureau to raise its mainland student enrolment cap from 30 per cent to 40 per cent after fully utilising its current quota this academic year, Lau said, while pledging strict vetting against fake academic credentials. 'Students come here to learn real skills, not expecting to simply buy a diploma,' Lau said, highlighting that THEi will never compromise its standards.

zh_title: 瑞士月重返香港展示现代、多元化的瑞士
summary: 瑞士月重返香港展示现代、多元化的瑞士 |中国劳工布告栏 星期一, 2026 年 11 月 23 日 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 瑞士月重返香港，展示现代、多元化的瑞士 第二届瑞士月重返香港，突出超越阿尔卑斯山刻板印象的当代瑞士。为期一个月的活动包括美食、设计和商务活动。总领事丹尼尔·弗雷霍费尔 (Daniel Freihofer) 强调，此次活动旨在促进更深层次的双边关系，并展示第二届瑞士月已回归
content:
瑞士月重返香港展示现代、多元化的瑞士 |中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 23 日星期一 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
瑞士月重返香港展示现代、多元化的瑞士
第二届瑞士月回到香港，突出超越阿尔卑斯山刻板印象的当代瑞士。为期一个月的活动包括美食、设计和商务活动。丹尼尔·弗雷霍费尔总领事强调此次活动旨在加深双边关系并展示
第二届瑞士月重返香港，旨在呈现当代瑞士超越传统阿尔卑斯山刻板印象的多面形象。瑞士驻香港总领事 Daniel Freihofer 表示，为期一个月的计划代表了一项战略努力，旨在突显该国的多样性和优势，同时促进与香港更深层次的双边关系。
“我们的目标是将瑞士描绘成一个现代化、多元化的国家，而不仅仅是巧克力、奶酪和山脉，”弗赖霍费尔说，并将该计划描述为公众发现国家多面身份的一扇敞开的大门。继 2024 年首届瑞士月取得成功之后，今年的瑞士月已从最初的简单“瑞士日”概念大幅扩展至涵盖艺术和文化、商业和金融、美食和酒店、科学和创新以及旅游和体育。
弗赖霍费尔指出，瑞士和香港在地缘政治和经济上有相似之处，包括相似的人口规模，都是首要的金融中心、高度开放的经济体以及与各自地区紧密联系的战略门户枢纽。香港仍然是瑞士在亚洲的第三或第四大商业伙伴，约有300家瑞士公司落户香港。传统上，最大的行业是金融服务和奢侈品零售，尤其是制表业，因为香港一直位居全球瑞士手表前三、四名市场之列。
今年的瑞士月特别强调美食，整个 11 月都会举办美食体验活动，由米其林星级厨师 Tanja Grandits 主持的节目尤为突出。 Freihofer 认为，食物为体验瑞士创造力提供了一种便捷的媒介，并指出，瑞士美食深受法国、德国和意大利美食的影响，已经发展成为一种独特的风格。餐饮业在香港已颇具影响力，半岛酒店的 Chesa 等地标餐厅已有超过 50 年的历史，供应瑞士美食，而由瑞士糕点师 Gregoire Michaud 创立的 Bakehouse 也已成为家喻户晓的名字。
设计是贯穿瑞士月的一条主线，各种展览、讲座和创意活动强调设计不仅是一门美学学科，而且是创新和跨文化对话的主要驱动力。 Freihofer 强调，实用性和功能性仍然是瑞士设计的核心。瑞士首次作为官方合作伙伴国参加 2026 年设计商业周，汇聚了 20 位瑞士顶尖设计人物作为特邀演讲者。香港M+博物馆建筑由瑞士赫尔佐格与德梅隆建筑事务所设计，该事务所还改造了历史悠久的大馆遗址。
瑞士月还将庆祝瑞士对塑造香港酒店业的影响

Monday, 23 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Swiss Month returns to Hong Kong showcasing modern, diverse Switzerland
The second edition of Swiss Month has returned to Hong Kong, highlighting contemporary Switzerland beyond alpine stereotypes. The month-long programme features gastronomy, design, and business events. Consul General Daniel Freihofer emphasised the event aims to foster deeper bilateral ties and showc
The second edition of Swiss Month has returned to Hong Kong, aiming to present a multi-faceted image of contemporary Switzerland that goes beyond traditional alpine stereotypes. Consul General of Switzerland in Hong Kong Daniel Freihofer said the month-long programme represents a strategic effort to highlight the country's diversity and strengths while fostering deeper bilateral ties with the city.
“We aim to portray Switzerland as a modern, diverse country which is much more than chocolate, cheese, and mountains,” Freihofer said, describing the programme as an open door for the public to discover the nation's multi-faceted identity. Following the success of its inaugural edition in 2024, this year's Swiss Month has expanded significantly from its initial concept of a simple 'Swiss Day' to span arts and culture, business and finance, gastronomy and hospitality, science and innovation, and tourism and sports.
Freihofer noted that Switzerland and Hong Kong share geopolitical and economic parallels, including similar population sizes, both being premier financial centres, highly open economies, and strategic gateway hubs deeply interconnected with their respective regions. Hong Kong remains Switzerland's third or fourth largest business partner in Asia, with about 300 Swiss companies based in the city. The largest sectors have traditionally been financial services and luxury retail, particularly watchmaking, as Hong Kong consistently ranks among the top three or four markets globally for Swiss watches.
This year's Swiss Month places special emphasis on gastronomy, with culinary experiences taking place throughout November highlighted by a programme featuring Michelin-starred chef Tanja Grandits. Freihofer believes food offers an accessible medium to experience Swiss creativity, noting that Swiss gastronomy, heavily influenced by French, German and Italian cuisines, has evolved into a distinct style. The culinary presence is already well-established in Hong Kong, with landmarks such as Chesa at The Peninsula serving Swiss cuisine for more than five decades, and Bakehouse, founded by Swiss pastry chef Gregoire Michaud, becoming a household name.
Design serves as a connecting thread throughout Swiss Month, with various exhibitions, talks and creative initiatives highlighting design not only as an aesthetic discipline but as a primary driver of innovation and cross-cultural dialogue. Freihofer emphasised that practicality and functionality remain at the core of Swiss design. For the first time, Switzerland is participating as the official Partner Country at Business of Design Week 2026, bringing together 20 leading Swiss design figures as featured speakers. Hong Kong's M+ Museum building was designed by Swiss architectural practice Herzog & de Meuron, which also remodelled the historic Tai Kwun heritage site.
Swiss Month will also celebrate the impact Switzerland has had on shaping Hong Kong's hospitality sector. Freihofer noted that several high-level management figures at luxury hotels such as The Peninsula Hong Kong have been Swiss nationals, while Hugo Montanari, managing director of Rosewood Hong Kong, is also Swiss. The consulate will publish a commemorative book to celebrate 25 Swiss nationals who have left their mark on Hong Kong and Macau's hospitality sector. Looking ahead, Freihofer identified life sciences, biotechnology and medical technology as promising future sectors, along with gold trading, with two Swiss gold refineries having recently established regional offices in Hong Kong.

title: AI股暴跌後美股期貨反彈 中韓台出手穩市
summary: 資料照，紐約證券交易所（NYSE），交易員和金融專業人士於開盤鐘聲響起時在交易大廳內忙碌工作。(Drew Angerer/Getty Images) 【大紀元2026年11月23日訊】（大紀元記者陳霆綜合報導）全球人工智能（AI）相關股票上週遭猛烈拋售後，美國股指期貨週一（11月23日）在亞洲交易時段強勁反彈。亞洲股市走勢分歧，韓股一度重挫逾4%，中國及香港股市下跌，台股則在劇烈震盪後翻紅。中韓台當局已相繼宣布穩市措施。 這波跌勢不僅重創科技及半導體股，也引發市場對AI巨額投
content:
資料照，紐約證券交易所（NYSE），交易員和金融專業人士於開盤鐘聲響起時在交易大廳內忙碌工作。(Drew Angerer/Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月23日訊】（大紀元記者陳霆綜合報導）全球人工智能（AI）相關股票上週遭猛烈拋售後，美國股指期貨週一（11月23日）在亞洲交易時段強勁反彈。亞洲股市走勢分歧，韓股一度重挫逾4%，中國及香港股市下跌，台股則在劇烈震盪後翻紅。中韓台當局已相繼宣布穩市措施。
這波跌勢不僅重創科技及半導體股，也引發市場對AI巨額投資回報的疑慮。投資者擔心，以大量借貸支撐的數據中心建設，能否產生足夠收益，以償還債務並支持企業估值。
週一亞洲早盤，標普500期貨上漲逾2%，納斯達克100期貨漲近3%。此前，標普500已連續七個交易日下跌，進入技術性回調區間；納斯達克綜合指數上週下跌10%，創2020年3月COVID-19疫情引發市場恐慌以來最大單週跌幅。
截至週一上午約10時20分，台灣加權指數報36,149.90點，上漲0.32%，盤中高低相差逾1,200點。其中電子類股上漲0.77%，金融類股則下跌4.01%，表現明顯分歧。
韓國KOSPI指數早盤一度下跌逾4%，稍後報4,690.60點，跌3.68%。上海綜合指數下跌1.16%，香港恆生指數跌1.32%。日本股市則因「勤勞感謝日」休市。
台股上週累計下跌約17.5%，創1990年以來最大單週跌幅；費城半導體指數上週五下挫10%。華爾街恐慌指數VIX也升至2025年4月以來最高，超過今年3月美伊戰事期間的水平。
台灣金管會上週六宣布，自週一起禁止以低於前一交易日收盤價的價格放空，並將最低融券保證金成數由130%提高至150%。財政部亦證實，國安基金已進場護盤。
韓國政府週日表示，正準備在必要時立即動用股市穩定基金；自週二起，也將放寬上市公司每日股票回購額度限制，為期三個月。
中國三大證券交易所則宣布，自11月30日起，將融資買股的最低保證金比例由100%降至80%，以支持股市。
路透社指出，投資者愈來愈擔憂，企業投入巨額資金興建AI數據中心未來能否獲得足夠回報。
此外，英偉達（Nvidia，輝達）共同創辦人黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）捲入與中國女商人黃樂（Alice Huang）的婚外情及中共間諜疑雲。英偉達於11月12日宣布黃仁勳已辭任執行長；AI公司Anthropic上市次日股價下跌8.5%，也加深市場疑慮。
摩根大通分析師在報告中表示：「我們重申，近期風險資產回調，主要是在市場情緒疲弱之際，AI投資去槓桿化所致，同時市場也正將美聯儲更偏鷹派的政策反應納入定價。」
不過，摩根大通仍認為，AI產業的長期成長趨勢並未改變。
高盛交易員則表示：「一般而言，像我們最近所見的恐慌，過去往往是開始增加風險部位的良好時機。」
但高盛也警告，投資者整體持倉仍偏高，市場可能尚未出現足以支撐強勁反彈的廣泛認賠拋售。
華爾街明星分析師艾夫斯（Dan Ives）認為，未來幾個月市場仍可能持續震盪，但AI產業的長期基本面依然強勁。

title: 《善男信女》奪金馬最佳劇情片 監製感嘆發行難
summary: 2026年11月22日，第63屆金馬獎頒獎典禮在台北流行音樂中心舉行。圖為最佳劇情片《善男信女》（We Are Born Good）劇組上台領獎。（台北金馬影展執委會提供） 【大紀元2026年11月23日訊】（大紀元記者鄭舒文報導）香港電影《善男信女》摘下第63屆金馬獎最佳劇情片，監製莊麗真致詞時坦言，如今電影宣傳與發行比拍攝更困難，感謝香港及台灣發行團隊努力吸引觀眾走進戲院。她也藉此殊榮呼籲觀眾給作品一個機會，進場支持電影。 《善男信女》由楊兩全自編自導，楊偉倫、鍾雪瑩領銜
content:
2026年11月22日，第63屆金馬獎頒獎典禮在台北流行音樂中心舉行。圖為最佳劇情片《善男信女》（We Are Born Good）劇組上台領獎。（台北金馬影展執委會提供）
【大紀元2026年11月23日訊】（大紀元記者鄭舒文報導）香港電影《善男信女》摘下第63屆金馬獎最佳劇情片，監製莊麗真致詞時坦言，如今電影宣傳與發行比拍攝更困難，感謝香港及台灣發行團隊努力吸引觀眾走進戲院。她也藉此殊榮呼籲觀眾給作品一個機會，進場支持電影。
《善男信女》由楊兩全自編自導，楊偉倫、鍾雪瑩領銜主演。故事以一場送錯的外賣為起點，茶餐廳老闆榮吉與年輕女子若蕾原本互不相識，卻因餐點誤會引發爭執，雙方各不相讓，衝突逐步升級，甚至展開互相報復。隨著彼此折騰，兩人也逐漸看見對方生活中的傷痛、無奈與孤獨，從針鋒相對走向理解。
2026年11月22日，第63屆金馬獎頒獎典禮在台北流行音樂中心舉行。圖為最佳劇情片Best Narrative Feature：《善男信女》（We Are Born Good）劇組上台領獎。（台北金馬影展執委會提供）
莊麗真致詞時表示，希望邀請團隊一同分享這份榮譽，坦言自己一時不知道該說什麼。她說：「我拍了一輩子的電影，終於有一天能夠站在這個舞台上，真的非常興奮。」她感謝香港「首部劇情電影計劃」，表示沒有這個計畫，就不會有這部電影，也感謝整個團隊在拍攝期間付出的心血與努力。
她指出，電影拍攝完成後，團隊還得投入宣傳工作，「其實在現在這個年代，我覺得宣傳和發行比拍攝電影更加困難」，並感謝香港的發行及宣傳公司，每天想盡辦法將觀眾帶進戲院，也謝謝台灣的發行公司及金馬獎評審團。莊麗真提到，《善男信女》已在台灣上映，希望觀眾能給電影一個機會。
導演兼編劇楊兩全則表示，這座獎對自己而言分量很重，但能夠捧起獎座，是因為團隊每一個人都非常出色，因此也向所有參與電影的人致謝。他最後呼籲觀眾走進戲院支持電影，並向金馬獎致謝。

title: Asian stock markets tumble as AI bubble fears mount
zh_title: 随着人工智能泡沫担忧加剧，亚洲股市暴跌
source: Al Jazeera – Breaking News, World News a
summary: 随着人工智能泡沫担忧加剧，亚洲股市暴跌商业和经济新闻|半岛电视台分享 社交媒体上人工智能泡沫担忧加剧，亚洲股市暴跌 2026 年 11 月 6 日，韩国首尔一家银行的交易室中，一名外汇交易商在显示韩国综合股票价格指数 (Kospi)、韩国证券交易商自动报价 (KOSDAQ) 以及美元与韩元之间汇率的电子板前工作 [Kim Hong-Ji/Reuters]对可持续发展的担忧
content:
随着人工智能泡沫担忧加剧，亚洲股市暴跌商业和经济新闻|半岛电视台
随着社交媒体上对人工智能泡沫的担忧加剧，亚洲股市暴跌
2026 年 11 月 6 日，韩国首尔一家银行的交易室中，一名货币交易商在显示韩国综合股票价格指数 (Kospi)、韩国证券交易商自动报价 (KOSDAQ) 以及美元与韩元之间汇率的电子板前工作 [Kim Hong-Ji/路透社]
由于人们越来越担心人工智能繁荣的可持续性，亚洲股市开盘就大幅下跌。
周一，韩国、台湾、香港和中国大陆的市场进一步陷入下跌，延续了周五太平洋两岸科技股主导的抛售潮。
4名民主党人中的名单1赢得了自1992年以来最大的众议院多数席位，并获得北卡罗来纳州席位
list 2 of 4特朗普将为他的模因币的最大所有者举办私人晚宴
清单 3（共 4）特朗普在推动美国参议院新的民主党领导层过程中批评舒默
4Lion在土耳其逍遥法外的名单4引发居民恐惧
首尔韩国综合股价指数 (Kospi) 下跌 5.8%，香港恒生指数下跌 1.8%。
沪深300指数跌幅超过1.3%，台湾证券交易所市值加权股票指数(Taiex)开盘跌幅超过1%后震荡上涨。
日本股市因劳动感恩节休市。
继周五亚洲股市暴跌之后，华尔街基准标准普尔 500 指数收盘下跌 3.7%，进入调整阶段——当市场从近期高点下跌 10% 或更多时，投资者会使用这个术语。
以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数下跌了 5.3%，抹去了 2026 年的全部涨幅，其中大约一半由“七大”人工智能公司组成。
韩国综合指数 (Kospi)、日经 225 指数和台湾证券交易所 (Taiex) 进入周末时均下跌 5.1% 至 6.2%，而恒生指数收盘下跌 1.9%。
周一，华尔街似乎有望反弹，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数期货分别上涨 2% 和 2.4%。
法国兴业银行亚洲股票策略师拉贾特·阿加瓦尔(Rajat Agarwal)表示，继上周下跌之后，投资者正试图评估市场调整是否“太过分”。
阿加瓦尔告诉半岛电视台：“我认为，在周五美国发生大规模抛售之后，市场正试图寻找一些支撑，科技指数出现了超过三个标准差的事件。”
投资者长期以来一直担心科技公司可能无法维持在训练和运行人工智能所需的基础设施上投入的数万亿美元投资。
根据技术洞察公司 Gartner 的数据，全球人工智能相关投资（其中大部分由债务推动）预计到 2026 年将达到 2.7 万亿美元，到 2027 年将达到 3.6 万亿美元。
越来越多的人呼吁加强对该行业的监管，这加剧了人们对人工智能繁荣可能失去动力的担忧。
民主党在美国中期选举中的压倒性胜利预计将放缓美国各州的数据中心建设速度，而芯片巨头英伟达及其前首席执行官黄仁勋涉嫌间谍丑闻导致对中国获取先进芯片的更严格限制。
澳新银行亚洲研究主管 Khoon Goh 告诉半岛电视台：“本周，随着投资者试图确定底部是否已接近，与人工智能相关的担忧将继续占据主导地位。”

Asian stock markets tumble as AI bubble fears mount | Business and Economy News | Al Jazeera

A currency dealer works in front of an electronic board displaying the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (Kospi), the Korea Securities Dealers Automated Quotations (KOSDAQ) and the exchange rate between the US dollar and South Korean won in the dealing room of a bank in Seoul, South Korea, on November 6, 2026 [Kim Hong-Ji/Reuters]
Asian stock markets have opened to sharp losses amid mounting concerns over the sustainability of the AI boom.
Markets in South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong and mainland China sank deeper into the red on Monday, continuing Friday’s tech-led sell-off on both sides of the Pacific.

list 3 of 4Trump criticises Schumer amid push for new Democrat leadership in US Senate

The Korea Composite Stock Price Index (Kospi) in Seoul slid as much as 5.8 percent, while Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index fell 1.8 percent.
The CSI 300 Index in Shanghai dropped more than 1.3 percent, while the Taiwan Stock Exchange Capitalization Weighted Stock Index (Taiex) swung between losses and gains after falling more than 1 percent at opening.
Japan’s stock markets were closed for Labour Thanksgiving Day.
Following Friday’s rout in Asia, Wall Street’s benchmark S&P 500 closed 3.7 percent lower to enter a correction – the term investors use when the market drops 10 percent or more from its recent high.
The tech-focused Nasdaq Composite, roughly half of which is made up of the “Magnificent Seven” AI-oriented firms, dropped 5.3 percent to erase all of its gains for 2026.
The Kospi, Nikkei 225, and the Taiex entered the weekend between 5.1 percent and 6.2 percent lower, while the Hang Seng Index finished down 1.9 percent.
Wall Street appeared on track for a rebound on Monday, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures up 2 percent and 2.4 percent, respectively.
After last week’s losses, investors are trying to assess if the market correction has “gone too far”, said Rajat Agarwal, an Asia equity strategist with Societe Generale.
“I think markets are trying to find some ground after a massive sell-off in US on Friday, a more than a three-standard-deviation event in tech indices,” Agarwal told Al Jazeera.
Investors have long been concerned that tech firms may not be able to sustain the multi-trillion-dollar investments they have poured into the infrastructure needed to train and run AI.
Global AI-related investment, much of it fuelled by debt, is expected to reach $2.7 trillion in 2026 and $3.6 trillion in 2027, according to technology insights company Gartner.
Concerns that the AI boom may be running out of steam have been exacerbated by growing calls for greater oversight of the sector.
The Democratic Party’s sweeping victory in the US midterm elections is expected to slow data centre construction in US states, while the alleged espionage scandal embroiling chip giant Nvidia and its former CEO Jensen Huang has led to a push for tighter restrictions on China’s access to advanced chips.
“AI-related concerns will continue to dominate this week, as investors try to determine if the bottom is near,” Khoon Goh, head of Asia research at ANZ, told Al Jazeera.
“A bright spot is that US equity futures are up, and South Korea reported very strong exports for the first 20 days of November, driven by semiconductor exports, which are up 294.4 percent year-on-year,” Goh said.

《纽约时报》称，爱丽丝黄在与英伟达首席执行官有染期间与中国间谍机构有联系
英伟达、黄仁勋和中国驻华盛顿大使馆的发言人没有立即回应置评请求
发布 - 2026 年 11 月 23 日上午 08:04 美国标准时间 - 华盛顿
黄浦江流过浦江淮扬菜餐厅餐厅的窗户，餐厅工作人员称，2026 年 11 月 12 日，爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 和 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 在上海共进晚餐。图片来源：路透社
据《纽约时报》周日（2026 年 11 月 22 日）报道，英伟达最近丑闻的核心人物爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 在与前首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的恋情期间与中国最高间谍机构的一名官员保持了一年多的联系。
报告援引了解描述此次遭遇的情报报告的人士称，从 2025 年春季到今年秋季，爱丽丝·黄一直与中国国家安全部的一名官员保持联系。
英伟达、黄仁勋和中国驻华盛顿大使馆的发言人没有立即回应置评请求。路透社尚未联系到爱丽丝黄请其置评。
报道称，与爱丽丝黄有关的中国公司获得了被禁的英伟达芯片
Alice Huang 此前领导过总部位于新加坡的 Megaspeed International，该公司是 Nvidia 的重要客户，曾占 Nvidia 芯片销售额数十亿美元。
自 2024 年以来，美国当局一直在调查 Megaspeed ，担心其将 Nvidia 的先进人工智能芯片走私到中国。
正如该报上个月报道的那样，周日（2026 年 11 月 22 日）的报告发布之际，美国官员对最初有关 Alice Huang 是间谍的说法表示怀疑。
10 月 29 日的那篇文章引发了一场丑闻，导致黄仁勋在两周后辞职，英伟达股价大幅下跌。
特朗普政府官员一再表示，他们尚未得出爱丽丝·黄为中国从事间谍活动的结论。
美国司法部长托德·布兰奇本月表示，司法部尚未就她是否是中国间谍得出结论。
美国国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿周日重申了这一点。
克莱顿对美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的“国情咨文”节目表示：“总检察长布兰奇已经非常明确地表示，黄女士及其公司正在对此事进行调查。” “我会让调查顺利进行。”
该丑闻还促使人们更深入地审视华盛顿对中国出口管制的方式，两党议员都质疑特朗普政府对珍贵半导体的执法和监管是否过于宽松。
路易斯安那州共和党参议员约翰·肯尼迪 (John Kennedy) 在 NBC 的“会见媒体”节目中表示，两人之间的恋情本身并不那么令人感兴趣。
“我希望他玩得开心，”肯尼迪先生周日（2026 年 11 月 22 日）说道。 “这是自特洛伊的海伦以来最昂贵的性行为。”
